questions.question: The professor explained _____ climate change has become a global concern.
questions.explanation_cn: explain 后接宾语从句。why 引导原因；because 不能直接引导宾语从句。
questions.explanation_en: 'Explain' is followed by a noun clause. 'Why' correctly introduces the clause, while 'because' cannot.

questions.question: _____ the new policy will reduce carbon emissions remains uncertain.
questions.explanation_cn: 主语从句表示'是否'时，通常使用 whether，不用 if。
questions.explanation_en: 'Whether' is preferred in subject clauses. 'If' is generally not used in this position.

questions.question: Scientists have not yet discovered _____ caused the sudden decline in biodiversity.
questions.explanation_cn: what 在从句中作主语，表示'什么导致了……'；that 在从句中不充当成分。
questions.explanation_en: 'What' functions as the subject of the clause, whereas 'that' introduces a clause without serving as a sentence element.

questions.question: The committee has not decided _____ the proposal should be approved.
questions.explanation_cn: decide whether... 是固定搭配，表示'决定是否……'。
questions.explanation_en: 'Decide whether...' is the correct structure when expressing uncertainty between alternatives.

questions.question: The fact _____ many endangered species are disappearing has raised global concern.
questions.explanation_cn: The fact that... 是 IELTS 写作和阅读中的高频同位语从句。
questions.explanation_en: 'The fact that...' is a common appositive clause in academic English.

questions.question: One reason for the increase in obesity is _____ people consume more processed food than ever before.
questions.explanation_cn: is that... 构成表语从句，是 IELTS 大作文中非常常见的表达。
questions.explanation_en: 'Is that...' introduces a predicative clause and is widely used in academic writing.

questions.question: The lecturer asked _____ the students had completed the reading assignment.
questions.explanation_cn: 宾语从句必须使用陈述语序，因此应为 if the students had completed...，不能倒装。
questions.explanation_en: Object clauses use statement word order. The correct structure is 'if the students had completed...'.

questions.question: _____ wins the scholarship will have the opportunity to study overseas.
questions.explanation_cn: Whoever 表示'无论谁'，可引导主语从句，是 IELTS 阅读中的常见结构。
questions.explanation_en: 'Whoever' means 'anyone who' and commonly introduces subject clauses.

questions.question: It is widely accepted _____ regular exercise improves both physical and mental health.
questions.explanation_cn: It is widely accepted that... 是 IELTS 写作中的经典句型，that 不可省略。
questions.explanation_en: 'It is widely accepted that...' is one of the most common academic sentence patterns.

questions.question: The study demonstrates _____ people with higher levels of education tend to have healthier lifestyles.
questions.explanation_cn: demonstrate that...、show that...、indicate that... 都是 IELTS Academic 的高频表达。
questions.explanation_en: 'Demonstrate that...' is a common academic reporting structure in IELTS and PTE.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: The fact that technology is developing rapidly has changed the way people communicate.
The professor asked what did the students think about the experiment.
It is widely believed that climate change requires international cooperation.
Whether the project succeeds depends on adequate funding.

questions.explanation_cn: A 正确：The fact that... 为同位语从句。B 错误：宾语从句应使用陈述语序，应为 'what the students thought...'。C 正确：It is widely believed that... 是学术英语固定表达。D 正确：Whether 引导主语从句。
questions.explanation_en: A correctly uses an appositive clause. B is incorrect because object clauses require statement word order. C correctly uses the academic structure 'It is widely believed that...'. D correctly uses a subject clause introduced by 'Whether'.
